issue.title: Plan-budget capsules in the idle-agenda title row
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-66.7 note #4 (epic bob-cli-66 closeout follow-up, triaged by bob-cli-66.land). Add bob plan budget capsules (for example, remaining Pomodoro budget for the day) to the idle agenda's title row next to the 'N done · Xh Ym' summary. The facts must come from a bob JSON interface, never from app-side vault reads, and must fit the title row's quiet tertiary style.

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Plan plan:202610/idle_capture_pomodoro_agenda.md (epic bob-cli-66) settled the v1.1 agenda interactions as out of scope: keyboard focus never leaves the editor and rows are read-only in v1. The accepted decision decisions:idle-capture-shows-ledger-agenda lists row clicks, keyboard navigation, and ⌘1…9 insertion under 'Reopens when', so this work should revisit that record.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-66.7 recorded this follow-up; the plan listed plan-budget capsules as out of scope for the v1 agenda.
